hypotheses.explanation: The checkout-to-payment Charge client span errors, and the checkout PlaceOrder server span and its frontend caller also fail; the other observed checkout dependencies succeed.
A frontend Currency Convert client span lasts about 97 ms while the corresponding currency-service server span is about 0.25 ms; frontend call durations also exceed currency-service durations.
Two GET /cart server spans fail although the cart-service GetCart and Redis calls shown in their traces succeed, suggesting failure within the frontend operation.
